_comment: CRITERION OVERRIDES for the frozen BYOK border-design corpus (track byok_svg_borders_20260927).
A per-design `criterion` normally comes from the round file that WON the freeze (last-
accepted-wins), so the criterion a design is judged by is the one its frozen bytes were
generated for. That invariant is deliberately OVERRIDABLE, once, by an operator ruling:
when a criterion is re-cut WITHOUT regenerating the artwork (the bytes stay the winning
round's), the freeze takes the criterion from THIS file and records both texts on the
fixture entry (`criterion` = the override, `criterionGenerated` = the round file's text,
`criterionOverride` = the provenance). The override file is a freeze INPUT, so a fresh
freeze over the same rounds + this file is still byte-reproducible.
Only ONE override exists, and it is the operator's D-C ruling (2026-10-01,
aspect-independently because the product's `border-image` edge scaling is ANISOTROPIC on
a tall section (~0.146 px/unit horizontal vs ~0.923 vertical with `round` on 656x1920),
so square scales become vertical slivers on the left/right rails while the top/bottom
rails keep the source's own proportions. The render knob did NOT move; the criterion did.

04-dragon-scale.criterion: Overlapping scale shapes are drawn in rows along the border, each scale visibly tucked under or over its neighbour; the individual scales are judged where the pipeline paints them at the source's own proportions — the top and bottom rails — and the left and right rails must carry the same overlapping-row texture even where the pipeline's anisotropic edge scaling narrows the individual scales.
04-dragon-scale.supersedes: Overlapping scale shapes are drawn in rows along the border, each scale visibly tucked under or over its neighbour, and the rows read as the same texture on the left/right as on the top/bottom.
04-dragon-scale.reason: Operator ruling D-C: the frozen 4c blob (800x800, filled paths) is deformed by anisotropic border-image edge scaling on the 656x1920 gallery section; the ruling re-cut the criterion aspect-independently and kept the render knobs unchanged, so the criterion now judges the source's proportions where the pipeline preserves them and only demands texture (not aspect) on the anisotropic rails.
